item.guhs.vr_amb_verhaal_kompaskoord.lor: A compass needle of the old Star Guhs only turns on a thread that glitters like the night.
item.guhs.vr_amb_verhaal_koraallampion.l: Glows pink in the dark, so lost cuddles find their way home.
item.guhs.vr_amb_verhaal_lijmdrankje.lor: Sticks everything. Your paws too, so no tasting.
item.guhs.vr_amb_verhaal_tempelsleutel.l: Made of mushwood and fluff iron. Fits the great door of the Shroom Temple exactly.
item.guhs.vr_amb_verhaal_warme_kandijsoe: For cold paws. According to Granny Trudy, for cold hearts too.
So soft that even a whale wants five more minutes under it.
vadsrijk.ambacht.eiland.bord.keuken: The Kitchen. Here you cook food with buffs and brew every potion, the Small Chonk Potion too. Herbs from the meadow, fish from the pond. Click Cook Nibbles and choose 'Workshop'.
vadsrijk.ambacht.eiland.bord.knutsel: Master Tinker's notice board: 1. Tap ore in the Pebble Quarry (north-west). 2. Pick herbs in the Flower Meadow (west). 3. Fish in the Fish Pond (south-east) or on the Fishing Pier (far west). 4. Smith in the Smithy, cook in the Kitchen. 5. Don't forget: a biscuit now and then.
vadsrijk.ambacht.eiland.bord.smederij: The Smithy. Here you forge rings, necklaces, earrings and bracelets, and you pick the bonuses yourself. Ore and wood come from the quarry and the grove. Click Smithguh Sparky and choose 'Workshop'.
vadsrijk.ambacht.eiland.bord.verzamelhui: The Gathering Hut. Right-click a glittering spot: you tap ore, chop wood, pick herbs and give bees a puff of smoke. The chonkier you play the little game, the finer your harvest.
vadsrijk.ambacht.eiland.bord.viswinkel: The Fish Shop. Where the water bubbles, there are fish. Right-click the bubbling spot, wait for 'Bite!' and click at once. At night and in the rain other fish bite. Fishguh Rodney tells you where.
vadsrijk.ambacht.eiland.bord.wegwijzer: Signpost. Square and Master Tinker: in the middle. Pebble Quarry: north-west. Cuddle Grove: north-east. Flower Meadow: west. Bee Garden: south-west. Fish Pond: south-east. Fishing Pier: far west, by the sea. Camp Snuggle: east, over the bridge.
vadsrijk.ambacht.eiland.bord.welkom: Welcome to the Craft Island! Here you learn the four crafts: Gathering, Fishing, Smithing and Cooking. Master Tinker stands on the round square. Everything grows back extra fast here, so practise all you like.
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.eiland_bijenhofje: the Bee Garden on the Craft Island
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.eiland_bloemenwei: the Flower Meadow on the Craft Island
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.eiland_bosje: the Cuddle Grove on the Craft Island
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.eiland_groeve: the Pebble Quarry on the Craft Island
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.eiland_vissteiger: the Fishing Pier of the Craft Island
vadsrijk.ambacht.groep.eiland_visvijver: the Fish Pond on the Craft Island
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.brief: Master Tinker sent you a letter: 'Dear adventurer, will you come and learn the crafts on the Craft Island? The lantern path starts at the Camp Snuggle campfire. Bring your paws!'
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.gemist: New in the story: craft steps! You missed %s of them. They are in your quest log (J). You need them for the next zone.
vadsrijk.ambacht.verhaal.verkeerd: Mind you: this is plain %s. Your story step asks for '%s': it is at the top of the workshop's recipe list.
vadsrijk.ambacht.werk.verhaal_niet: You only make this when the story asks for it.
vadsrijk.npc.plek.npc.meester_knutsel: on the round square of the Craft Island, west of Camp Snuggle (over the lantern bridge)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.amb_keuken_z2: at the cook on the Sugarbowl square
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.amb_keuken_z3: at the cook on the Honeybough market
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.amb_smidse_z1: at the smith on the Shroomsbury square (or in the Smithy on the Craft Island)
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.amb_z1_erts: by the ore veins in the Drip Caves, in the north-west
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.amb_z1_hout: by the stumps in the Sporewood, west of Shroomsbury
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.amb_z2_vis: at the bubbling spots in the Snuggle Lake
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.amb_z3_hout: by the dusk trees in the Glowbeetle Woods
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.amb_z3_korf: by the beehives on the Combmeadow
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.amb_z4_duik: at the diving jetty in Coral Bay
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.amb_z5_erts: on Mother Cloudwhale's north fin, by Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.amb_z5_wol: in the arbour of the Tail Park in Highchonk
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.amb_z6_erts: by the ore veins in the Singing Salt Cave, under the Salt Flats
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.amb_z6_zijde: by the mulberry trees in the Palm Gorges, where the silkworms live
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.ambacht_bloemenwei: in the Flower Meadow, in the west of the Craft Island
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.ambacht_brug_kamp: at the end of the lantern path, west of the Camp Snuggle campfire: over the bridge to the Craft Island
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.ambacht_groeve: in the Pebble Quarry, in the north-west of the Craft Island
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.ambacht_keuken: in the Kitchen on the square of the Craft Island
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.ambacht_knutsel: on the round square of the Craft Island
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.ambacht_smederij: in the Smithy on the square of the Craft Island
vadsrijk.npc.plek.poi.ambacht_visvijver: at the Fish Pond, in the south-east of the Craft Island
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_kok_eiland.1: Tasting is fine, snacking is not!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_kok_eiland.2: A feast only tastes great with your whole party.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_kok_eiland.3: Bubble, bubble, burble... who wants a potion?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_smid_eiland.2: A good ring is like a cuddle: sturdy but sweet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_smid_eiland.3: Got a boss core? Then make a Masterwork!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_verzamel_eiland.3: A golden clover? Then you're lucky!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_verzamel_z2.3: A golden clover? Then you're lucky!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_verzamel_z3.3: A golden clover? Then you're lucky!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_vis_eiland.2: The biggest fish always just gets away.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_vis_eiland.3: Someday I'll fish on the Lantern Coast.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_vis_z2.2: The biggest fish always just gets away.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_vis_z2.3: Someday I'll fish on the Lantern Coast.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_vis_z3.2: The biggest fish always just gets away.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_vis_z3.3: Someday I'll fish on the Lantern Coast.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.meester_knutsel.1: A craft is a cuddle you make with your paws.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.meester_knutsel.2: I built this island myself. Well, the bridge. Well, one plank.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.meester_knutsel.3: Gathering, fishing, smithing, cooking. Four crafts, one heart. And lots of crumbs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03d_knutsel.aanbod.0: Tidied up is neat! But you know what's even neater? Home-made.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03d_knutsel.aanbod.1: See that path with the little lanterns? It goes to the Craft Island. Master Tinker lives there. He teaches everyone to gather, fish, smith and cook.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03d_knutsel.aanbod.2: Right now? I was just about to have a biscuit.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03d_knutsel.aanbod.3: Right now! Whoever can make their own potions faints less often. Off you go, the campfire won't run away. I do, sometimes, to the biscuit tin.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03d_knutsel.bezig: Follow the lantern path west, over the bridge. Master Tinker stands on the round square.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03d_knutsel.doel.0: Walk over the lantern bridge to the Craft Island
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03d_knutsel.doel.1: Talk to Master Tinker on the square
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03d_knutsel.klaar.0: Hello, hello! A new apprentice! I'm Master Tinker. Have a look around: a quarry, a grove, a meadow, a pond and four workshops. All for you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03d_knutsel.klaar.2: Well, and for the other apprentices. And for the bees. But mostly for you! Shall we begin?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03d_knutsel.tekst: West of Camp Snuggle lies the Craft Island. There Master Tinker teaches you the four crafts: Gathering, Fishing, Smithing and Cooking. Follow the lantern path west from the campfire, over the bridge, and report to him on the round square.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03e_verzamelen.aanbod.0: Lesson one! Gathering. See those glittering spots? Right-click them. Ore: tap the glittering bit. Herbs: hold and let go in the green. Not too early, not too late. Just chonky.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03e_verzamelen.aanbod.1: Tap ore twice in the Pebble Quarry and pick a little bunch in the Flower Meadow. And then fishing! Right-click a bubbling spot in the pond, wait for 'Bite!' and click at once.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03e_verzamelen.aanbod.2: And if I click too early?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03e_verzamelen.aanbod.3: Then the fish gets a fright and swims off giggling. Fish are very ticklish. Just try again!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03e_verzamelen.bezig: Ore in the Pebble Quarry, herbs in the Flower Meadow, a fish in the Fish Pond. Right-click the glittering spots!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03e_verzamelen.doel.0: Tap ore twice in the Pebble Quarry
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03e_verzamelen.doel.1: Pick herbs in the Flower Meadow
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03e_verzamelen.doel.2: Catch a fish in the Fish Pond
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03e_verzamelen.klaar.0: Look at that! Ore, herbs and a little fish. All by yourself! I need to wipe away a little tear.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03e_verzamelen.klaar.1: On this island everything comes back after half a minute. Elsewhere in the Chonkdom it takes a bit longer: nature there is less impatient than me.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03e_verzamelen.tekst: Master Tinker's lesson one: Gathering and Fishing. Right-click a glittering spot and play the little game: you tap ore in the Pebble Quarry and pick herbs in the Flower Meadow. Then catch a fish in the Fish Pond. On the island everything grows back extra fast.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03f_maken.aanbod.0: Lesson two! Making. Here: five fluff iron, a shroom stem and some blob clover. From my own little stash. Don't tell the bees.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03f_maken.aanbod.1: In the Smithy you forge a ring. You choose two bonuses yourself. Strength? Life? Both? Choose with your heart, and a little with your head.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03f_maken.aanbod.2: And in the Kitchen you cook a Small Chonk Potion. It heals you when you've been cuddled a bit too hard by something. The shops only sell the small ones. The big ones you make yourself!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03f_maken.bezig: A ring in the Smithy, a Small Chonk Potion in the Kitchen. Click the master in the hut and choose 'Workshop'.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03f_maken.doel.0: Forge a ring in the Smithy
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03f_maken.doel.1: Cook a Small Chonk Potion in the Kitchen
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03f_maken.klaar.0: A real home-forged ring! And a potion that smells like Sunday. You're no apprentice any more. Well, a little bit still.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03f_maken.klaar.1: Here, some more Small Chonk Potions for the road. Later in the story you will really need the crafts: a key, a soup, a potion. Then you'll know how!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03f_maken.klaar.2: Now go back to Cook Crispycrust at the campfire. He's waiting with a biscuit. Or he ate it. That could be too.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03f_maken.tekst: Master Tinker's lesson two: Smithing and Cooking. He gave you some ore, wood and herbs. Forge a ring in the Smithy (click Smithguh Sparky and choose 'Workshop') and cook a Small Chonk Potion in the Kitchen (at Cook Nibbles). Then come back to him.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10a_zwamhout.aanbod.0: I have bad news. I looked through the keyhole of the great door, and the keyhole looked back, all grey.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10a_zwamhout.aanbod.1: Grey fluff! Stuffed full. Those Mikas. The old key won't open it any more. We need a new one, one that clicks right through fluff.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10a_zwamhout.aanbod.2: What do you make a key like that from?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10a_zwamhout.aanbod.3: From shroom stem out of the Sporewood and fluff iron out of the Drip Caves. Bring four of each. Then I'll tell you how to forge it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10a_zwamhout.bezig: Four shroom stem from the Sporewood and four fluff iron from the Drip Caves. Keep them with you, you need them for the key.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10a_zwamhout.doel.0: Chop 4 shroom stem in the Sporewood
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10a_zwamhout.doel.1: Tap 4 fluff iron in the Drip Caves
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10a_zwamhout.klaar.0: Fine stuff! That shroom stem still smells of forest, and that fluff iron shines like a freshly polished cheese nibble.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10a_zwamhout.klaar.1: Keep it with you. Now it still needs forging.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10a_zwamhout.tekst: The Mikas stuffed the lock of the great temple door with grey fluff. Temple Guard Stalky wants a new temple key. For that you need shroom stem, the tough mushwood of the Sporewood, and fluff iron from the dripstone veins of the Drip Caves.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10a_zwamhout.titel: Wood and iron for a key
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10b_tempelsleutel.aanbo: You don't forge a key with your head, but with your paws. Go to a smith: in Shroomsbury, or in Master Tinker's Smithy.
Choose 'Temple Key' in the workshop. You do need Smithing level 5, or it turns into a temple teaspoon.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10b_tempelsleutel.bezig: You forge the temple key at a smith (Smithing 5). Too low? Forge a few rings first, then it comes by itself.
Forge the temple key at a smith (Smithing 5)
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10b_tempelsleutel.klaar: Let me see... Click! It fits! Hear that? The grey fluff just crackles right off.
From now on the great door opens for whoever is strong enough. Are you level 18? Then talk to me again.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10b_tempelsleutel.tekst: Forge the temple key at a smith: in Shroomsbury or in the Smithy on the Craft Island. You need Smithing level 5. Bring the key to Temple Guard Stalky at the great door.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06a_ijsforellen.aanb: Pike's teeth are still chattering. Click-clack-click. He says it's music, but I know better.
What he needs is warm candy soup. With ice trout. The lake's ice trout are really called mirror trout: if you look closely, your reflection waves back.
Five. One for each paw, and one for the flavour. You do need Fishing level 12, they're clever little fish.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06a_ijsforellen.bezi: Five mirror trout from the Snuggle Lake. Fishing level 12, and patience.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06a_ijsforellen.doel: Catch 5 mirror trout in the Snuggle Lake (Fishing 12)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06a_ijsforellen.klaa: Five! They shine like new ice cubes. Keep them with you.
Now they still need cooking into soup. I can only boil water, and even that often burns.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06a_ijsforellen.teks: Fisher Pike is free again, but his paws are still ice-cold from the crystal. Ice Fisher Holey knows what to do: warm candy soup. Catch 5 mirror trout for it, the ice trout of the Snuggle Lake. You need Fishing level 12 for that.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06b_kandijsoep.aanbo: Granny Trudy wrote it down long ago: candy soup, for cold paws. Choose 'Warm Candy Soup' in a kitchen. Cooking level 12, mind you.
And no sipping on the way! I'll see it on your whiskers.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06b_kandijsoep.bezig: Warm candy soup, cooked in a kitchen (Cooking 12). For instance at the cook on the Sugarbowl square.
Cook warm candy soup in a kitchen (Cooking 12)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06b_kandijsoep.klaar: Mmm, smell that! Pike, come here. Slurp. Look, his little ears are going pink again.
Thank you, adventurer. I can feel my toes again. All seven.
Seven? We'll talk about that later. First that noise under the ice.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06b_kandijsoep.tekst: Cook warm candy soup from the mirror trout in a kitchen (Cooking level 12), for instance at the cook on the Sugarbowl square. Bring the soup to Ice Fisher Holey, and the frozen guard gets warm paws again.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07a_hars.aanbod.0: I just went to look at the cable bridge to the shipyard. The ropes hang there like limp spaghetti. Mika teeth marks, everywhere.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07a_hars.aanbod.1: But I know a glue potion. From pink resin and dusk honey. It sticks so well that my maps are still stuck to my table. For three years now.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07a_hars.aanbod.3: The dusk trees weep resin, pink and happy. The bees on the Combmeadow make the honey. Three resin and two honey, that's enough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07a_hars.bezig: Three pink resin from the dusk trees and two dusk honey from the Combmeadow. Keep them with you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07a_hars.doel.0: Gather 3 pink resin from the dusk trees (Gathering 22)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07a_hars.doel.1: Gather 2 dusk honey on the Combmeadow
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07a_hars.klaar.0: It's already sticking to your paws, I see. Good, then it's good stuff.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07a_hars.klaar.1: Now it still needs brewing. That has to be in a kitchen, or it turns into sticky tea.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07a_hars.tekst: The Mikas gnawed the ropes of the cable bridge to the shipyard loose. Mapmaker Loopy knows a glue potion that sticks everything back together. Gather pink resin from the dusk trees (Gathering 22) and dusk honey from the beehives on the Combmeadow.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07b_lijmdrankje.aanb: Choose 'Glue Potion' in a kitchen. Cooking level 22. And stir to the left, to the right the spoon gets stuck.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07b_lijmdrankje.bezi: You brew the glue potion in a kitchen (Cooking 22), for instance at the Honeybough market.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07b_lijmdrankje.doel: Brew the glue potion in a kitchen (Cooking 22)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07b_lijmdrankje.klaa: Perfect! I rub it into the ropes and... see that? Tight as a drum. The cable bridge is whole again.
And now my map is stuck to my paw. Doesn't matter. At least I won't lose it. On to the shipyard!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07b_lijmdrankje.teks: Brew the glue potion from the resin and the honey in a kitchen (Cooking level 22), for instance at the cook on the Honeybough market. Bring it to Mapmaker Loopy, and she sticks the cable bridge in the crown back together.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05a_koraal.aanbod.0: Do you know what I want for the party? A lantern that never goes out. Made of pink coral. Then every cuddle finds its way home, even when I'm asleep.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05a_koraal.aanbod.2: On the bottom of Coral Bay. So: diving! Four bits of coral and two sea sponges. Take air with you. As much as you can.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05a_koraal.bezig: Four pink coral and two sea sponges from Coral Bay (Fishing 32). Keep them with you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05a_koraal.doel.0: Dive up 4 pink coral in Coral Bay (Fishing 32)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05a_koraal.doel.1: Dive up 2 sea sponges in Coral Bay
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05a_koraal.klaar.0: How beautifully that shines! And the sponges squeak when you squeeze them. Don't. Okay, once.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05a_koraal.klaar.1: Now it still needs forging into a lantern. The harbour workshop can do that.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05a_koraal.tekst: For the home-coming party Foster Mom Softie wants a coral lantern on the jetty, so lost cuddles always find their way home. Dive in Coral Bay for pink coral and sea sponges (Fishing level 32).
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05b_lampion.aanbod.0: Choose 'Coral Lantern' in the harbour workshop. Smithing level 32. And make it a bit pink. Pinker. Yes, like that.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05b_lampion.bezig: You forge the coral lantern in the Lanternhaven workshop (Smithing 32).
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05b_lampion.doel.0: Forge the coral lantern in the harbour workshop (Smithing 32)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05b_lampion.klaar.0: Oh... It glows. Just as I dreamed. I'll hang it at the end of the jetty.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05b_lampion.klaar.1: Now the party can begin. Come, there's shell lemonade, and I didn't make it, so there's no sand in it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05b_lampion.tekst: Forge the coral lantern in the Lanternhaven workshop or in the Crafters' Guild of Highchonk (Smithing level 32). Bring it to Foster Mom Softie for the party.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08a_wolkenwol.aanbod: Wait a moment. Before you sing. Do you know what I always want when I wake up? Five more minutes. Under a blanket.
Mother Cloudwhale hasn't had a blanket in a hundred years. Let's make her one. From cloud wool, the softest there is.
A blanket for a whale? How big will that be?
Small. She puts it over her eye. Just like me. Five tufts of cloud wool from the gardens, please.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08a_wolkenwol.bezig: Five cloud wool from the gardens of Highchonk (Gathering 40). Keep them with you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08a_wolkenwol.doel.0: Pick 5 cloud wool in the gardens of Highchonk (Gathering 40)
So soft! I'd crawl under it myself. Don't tell the ladies of the court.
Now it still needs sewing. In the Crafters' Guild they sew everything. Even buttons on clouds.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08a_wolkenwol.tekst: Whoever wakes up wants five more minutes under a blanket first. Queen Gentleheart wants to give Mother Cloudwhale a cloud blanket before you sing the lullaby. Pick cloud wool in the gardens of Highchonk (Gathering level 40).
Choose 'Cloud Blanket' in the Guild workshop. Smithing level 40: our seamstresses are smiths too.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08b_dekentje.bezig: You sew the cloud blanket in the Crafters' Guild of Highchonk (Smithing 40).
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08b_dekentje.doel.0: Sew the cloud blanket in the Crafters' Guild (Smithing 40)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08b_dekentje.klaar.0: It's perfect. I'll lay it over her eye myself. She'll notice, even though she's as big as a city.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08b_dekentje.klaar.1: Go now. Sing the lullaby, the right way round. Then she wakes up under something soft.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08b_dekentje.tekst: Sew the cloud blanket in the Crafters' Guild of Highchonk, at the Smithing teacher (Smithing level 40). Bring it to Queen Gentleheart.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07a_zijde.aanbod.0: The Star Compass. I have drawings of it. See this little thread? The needle hangs on a cord of star silk. Without the cord it just spins in circles. Like me without tea.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07a_zijde.aanbod.1: Where do you find star silk?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07a_zijde.aanbod.2: You make it. The silkworms in the mulberry trees of the Palm Gorges spin the softest thread of the Silklands. A thread of star gold from the Singing Salt Cave goes through it. Then it glitters like the night.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07a_zijde.bezig: Three silk thread from the Palm Gorges and two star gold from the Singing Salt Cave (Gathering 48). Keep them with you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07a_zijde.doel.0: Pick 3 silk thread by the mulberry trees in the Palm Gorges
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07a_zijde.doel.1: Tap 2 star gold in the Singing Salt Cave
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07a_zijde.klaar.0: Yes! That's it. I can already feel the stars tickling in it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07a_zijde.klaar.1: Now it still needs forging into a cord. The teacher in the smithy of the Grand Bazaar does that. They have the finest needles of Saffron Gate.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07a_zijde.tekst: The Star Compass of the old Star Guhs only turns on a cord of star silk. Stargazer Twinkle knows you spin that from silk thread from the mulberry trees of the Palm Gorges, with a thread of star gold from the Singing Salt Cave (Gathering level 48).
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07b_kompaskoord.aanb: Choose 'Star-silk Compass Cord' in the bazaar smithy. Smithing level 48, it's very fine work. Don't breathe too hard, or it blows away.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07b_kompaskoord.bezi: You forge the compass cord in the smithy of the Grand Bazaar in Saffron Gate (Smithing 48).
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07b_kompaskoord.doel: Forge the compass cord in the smithy of the Grand Bazaar (Smithing 48)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07b_kompaskoord.klaa: It glitters like the night. Just like in the drawing. Now the compass can turn again.
On to the Sunken Observatory. The compass is waiting there for its cord.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07b_kompaskoord.teks: Forge the star-silk compass cord in the smithy of the Grand Bazaar in Saffron Gate, at Mentor Smithguh Saffron (Smithing level 48). Bring it to Stargazer Twinkle.
